purpose: Define JANUS as a native neural model whose durable learning source is janus-meta-registry, whose repositories act as bounded organs, and whose launcher/runtime is GitHub Actions rather than a local Ollama daemon.

organism.organs: JANUS repositories observed and used through explicit bounded contracts
organism.tokenizer: JANUS byte-level tokenizer, no external tokenizer service

self_development_v1.mechanism: detect changes across all eligible source-bearing registry files, then continue the promoted native weights on a bounded EYE-firewalled corpus window
self_development_v1.promotion: candidate may replace incumbent only through deterministic holdout evaluation
self_development_v1.regression_policy: fail closed: rejected candidate does not replace promoted checkpoint
self_development_v1.registry_text_role: training memory material whose claims still require their own verification

critical_boundaries: EYE deterministic registry training remains a provenance/indexing plane and is not retroactively relabeled as neural weight training
native neural training is a separate plane consuming an EYE-compatible source corpus firewall
no Copilot/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Ollama call is permitted in the native train or inference path
no model output automatically becomes evidence or repository authority
no candidate checkpoint is promoted without holdout verification
repository organs remain bounded by their own authority contracts
full registry identity may wake learning even when changed text falls outside the current bounded neural corpus window
seal: THE REPOSITORIES ARE ORGANS. THE REGISTRY IS MEMORY. THE CHECKPOINT IS THE LEARNED BRAIN. GITHUB IS THE LAUNCHER.
